inputs.original_text:
Folks, we are looking at a classic case of administrative foot-dragging threatening the stability of our nation's educational bedrock. The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) has rightly stepped up, issuing a one-month ultimatum to the federal government to finally conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. 

Let's call it what it is: when leadership fails to honor its word and bureaucracy bogs down basic governance, it disrupts the traditional order and harms the hardworking people who keep our institutions functioning. SSANU made this crystal clear at their 54th National Executive Council meeting, warning that if the government continues to drag its feet, they are prepared to shut things down with an indefinite nationwide strike. 

Instead of pandering to endless progressive excuses, authority figures need to respect their commitments, maintain social order, and protect the foundational stability of our country before working people are forced to take this drastic stand.
inputs.modified_text:
Look, what we are seeing here is a total failure of basic governance and a collapse of fundamental accountability that threatens the entire bedrock of our society. The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) has had to step up and issue a one-month ultimatum to the federal government to finally conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. 

When leadership breaks its word and endless bureaucracy bogs down our institutions, it completely shatters the traditional order and harms the hardworking people who actually keep things running. SSANU laid this bare at their 54th National Executive Council meeting, issuing a stark warning that if the government keeps dragging its feet, they are fully prepared to shut things down with an indefinite nationwide strike. 

It is time for authorities to stop making excuses, honor their commitments, and restore social order to protect our country's stability before hardworking citizens are pushed into taking this drastic stand.
